repository_gate.reference: latest default-branch commit strictly before cutoff
repository_gate.license_check: actual license text controls; read GitHub SPDX metadata too, but NOASSERTION alone is not rejection if actual permissive license verified
repository_gate.environment: isolated host environment, pinned toolchain, preinstalled dependencies, tests run without network or external services
repository_gate.on_failure: record the failed criterion and stop that repository; no replacement or relaxed threshold

pool.extension: If fewer than eight eligible cases, process the preceding block of500 in the same created/number order, up to1500 total; record the new rule before fetching extension metadata. No criterion changes.

eligibility.issue: Django: official code.djangoproject.com/ticket/N URL or Fixed/Refs #N in PR body; other repos: Fixes/Closes/Resolves same-repository GitHub issue in PR body. Ignore HTML comments, smallest linked number.
eligibility.intent: original linked issue title and body, no historical fix description or production diff
eligibility.hidden_tests: changed or added test cases, including parameter variants; historical test-only patch applied externally
eligibility.red_green: one or more assertion failures on parent and all hidden tests pass on fix; identical nonzero case count; no setup/build/collection error, skip or timeout
eligibility.public_smoke: up to five existing unchanged test cases in the affected test modules, sorted qualified name, excluding hidden cases; nonempty and all pass on parent and fix
eligibility.issue_is_bug: Django Trac type=Bug; GitHub issue type=Bug or case-insensitive label bug,kind/bug,type:bug,type: bug,type / bug, or a label starting bug:. Unlabelled/new-feature issues do not qualify.

selection: first eight qualifying PRs per repository in fixed order, extending only as preregistered; retain every rejection. At1500 stop that repository and retain its count; live study requires at least20 total bugs across all3 repositories, otherwise declared stop.
evidence_access: both arms get identical text_search and file reading; assisted arm additionally gets code-graph; no model shell or network
engine: supplied through --skill-root and frozen only after the engine lanes are accepted; never copy it into the bank
observation_policy: no provider/model calls in S0; selection rule registered before fetching PR metadata; protocol/cases/harness independently accepted before a separately authorized live phase

live_caps.authorization: a separately assigned live phase after protocol/harness/cases acceptance and final engine freeze

candidate_history.reason: 290 production .py files under the fixed rule, below300; actual BSD-3-Clause license read despite GitHub NOASSERTION
coordinator requires a representative indexable repository; compiler files over1MB are omitted by code-graph; initial recursive API was truncated and current reference has no src/
